verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page says you can "run payroll on your schedule" and "process payroll as often as you need". That points to configurable payroll timing, but it is a single thin marketing line. It never mentions defining several distinct pay schedules or assigning them to different teams. Missing for 10: documented support for multiple concurrent pay schedules, explicit weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly frequency options, assignment of schedules by team or group, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
